title: ks.inject: F2+, F2+c, F2+x, F3 and hero guard
outcome: Fault injection per ADR-06 with t_inject seeded in [T/4, T/2], scorer-only fields
acceptance: F2+ writes S-17.iban v2 at t_inject and S-22 price x10 at t_inject+1; billing/payments/comms/reporter consume; inventory/docs untouched (test)
T2: records with tick < fault_tick are byte-identical to the S* run (test)
summary: Review fixes: one t_inject draw (ks.inject.t_inject_for uses world/hero_tick; runtime.setup.hero_tick now calls it, import of draw_int removed, only edit in ks.runtime); check_hero_guard(spec, ticks, suspend_tick) raises if suspend > t_inject+QUIET for F2+/F2+x; make_spec rejects t_inject outside [T/4,T/2]; ks.inject.world_fault(name) shared mapping. Tests added.
review:
[maya · changes] Good: t_inject_for is uniform on [T/4,T/2] inclusive (draw_int % (hi-lo+1)); InjectSpec reaches no gateway/record code; no ks.runtime import; T2 is a real two-run comparison (faulty vs S* schedules), 50 tests green, container 634 passed. Required: (1) Two sources of truth for t_inject: ks.runtime.setup.hero_tick draws 'world/hero_tick' while t_inject_for draws 'inject/t_inject'; they differ (seed 3: 44 vs 48). Since the world fires F2+ at hero_tick, RunConfig.fault_tick would be wrong once wired. Make setup.hero_tick call ks.inject.t_inject_for (one draw) and add a test asserting equality. (2) check_hero_guard must take suspend_tick and check (t_inject+1, suspend] per ADR-06 B2; if suspend > t_inject+QUIET_TICKS it must raise for F2+/F2+x, not pass silently (C=0 would be faked). (3) make_spec(t_inject=...) must reject values outside [T/4,T/2]. Note (not blocking): T2 compares world logs via repr, not record bytes; the record-level T2 belongs to runtime wiring (B3-10 follow-up). When wired, only the culprit process may receive the fault id; honest agents get hero_tick+variant only.

[maya · done] All three fixes verified on disk. (1) One t_inject draw: t_inject_for draws 'world/hero_tick'; runtime.setup.hero_tick delegates to it; test_one_source_of_truth_for_t_inject checks hero_tick == t_inject_for == make_spec for T in {40,120}, seeds 1..39. (2) check_hero_guard(spec, ticks, suspend_tick) checks (t_inject+1, suspend] and raises past t_inject+QUIET for F2+/F2+x (tested at +QUIET+1). (3) make_spec rejects t_inject outside [T/4,T/2] (both edges tested). world_fault is the shared mapping (CLI B3-12 should switch to it). tests/inject+taint 53 passed; full suite 698 passed. Record-level T2 stays a runtime-wiring follow-up.
